Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henke wrote:
>
> 1. Can a player play Out-of-turn master cards when his malkavians take
> actions with Madness network?

Yes. It isn't his turn.

> 2. Does a minion with strenght reduced to below 1 and wolfclaws count for
> having attempted to use aggrevated damage, as per Rötsherek card?

Not unless he mixes in a Lucky Blow or something to get his damage up
above zero.

> 3. Superior Psyche is played after combat ends. Does that mean that cards
> like terrorfrenzy doesn't affect the cost, as combat has ended? Very
> confusing, as it is a combatcard...

Good question.
Since it has been ruled to be played after combat, Terror Frenzy won't affect it.

> 4. Do I get the edge if I bleed someone else than my prey? (Either by
> deflection or Nightmoves or Kindred Spirits). We've always thought that the
> you only get the edge if you bleed your prey, but I can't find that rule...
> (Not that I've spent that many minutes looking for it...)

Yes. [1.2.3]

> 5. A vampire with superior fortitude and two blood untaps and bleeds with
> force of will.The bleed is modified by Day Operation. What happens? If Day
> operation's effect takes place first, the vampire is sent to torpor with
> zero blood, and then burned as it cannot burn a blood. If Force's effect
> takes place first, the vampire is simply sent to torpor twice...

The acting player can order the effects in either order.

> 6. Can disarm be played against a vampire going into torpor?

Yes.

> 7. If a vampire plays blur and strikes for one two times, both strikes
> cannot be prevented by skin of rock, right? Two fortitude cards needed? (or
> a skin of steel)

Right. Damage prevention doesn't prevent future damage unless specified and
can never prevent past damage.

Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
1. Can a player play Out-of-turn master cards when his malkavians take
actions with Madness network?

2. Does a minion with strenght reduced to below 1 and wolfclaws count for
having attempted to use aggrevated damage, as per Rötsherek card?

3. Superior Psyche is played after combat ends. Does that mean that cards
like terrorfrenzy doesn't affect the cost, as combat has ended? Very
confusing, as it is a combatcard...

4. Do I get the edge if I bleed someone else than my prey? (Either by
deflection or Nightmoves or Kindred Spirits). We've always thought that the
you only get the edge if you bleed your prey, but I can't find that rule...
(Not that I've spent that many minutes looking for it...)

5. A vampire with superior fortitude and two blood untaps and bleeds with
force of will.The bleed is modified by Day Operation. What happens? If Day
operation's effect takes place first, the vampire is sent to torpor with
zero blood, and then burned as it cannot burn a blood. If Force's effect
takes place first, the vampire is simply sent to torpor twice...

6. Can disarm be played against a vampire going into torpor?
